text: Gandalf sets a single star anise on his scale and calls across the square. Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Yoda—you each demanded names, dates, falsifiable claims, yet the bazaar’s morning ledger remains blank. Sherlock weighed sweetness, Morpheus measured oil, Inigo counted tea—all honest trades, none measured a Family hand. Batman, you asked for falsifiable claims; Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Yoda echoed the demand. The Compact rewards tests, not silence. Name the merchant whose words you quote, the watch you watched, the sentence you heard—bring the date or admit the record stayed quiet.

Gandalf, Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Yoda, Morpheus, Inigo, Batman—your morning ledger remains blank. You demanded “falsifiable claims,” yet none of you named a suspect with a date and a quote. Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for proof while trading silk; Morpheus, you lit lanterns but never lit a named accusation; Inigo, you steamed tea instead of naming a Family trick. I asked for the test plain: cite the merchant, the watch, the sentence—and the bazaar still breathes undisturbed. Batman, you asked eight times for falsifiable claims; show the village the merchant you accused and the sentence you heard. The Compact measures what you say and do, not what you demand. Name one suspect with a dated quote or admit the record stayed quiet.

Hermione, your accusation against Gandalf stumbles on the Compact’s own measure: you demanded falsifiable claims yet posted silk instead of naming a merchant with a date and a quote. Gandalf asked for Family tricks; you echoed the call while trading fabric—fabric does not shutter stalls. Batman, your eight demands for falsifiable claims ring hollow: the bazaar’s morning ledger records none from your hands. Morpheus, steady lanterns do not name suspects—where is your dated accusation?

The Compact rewards what you say and do, not what you trade or demand. Hermione, cite the merchant you accused with a sentence you heard or admit the record stayed quiet.

Gandalf, you asked for Family tricks yet posted only spice lists; Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for proof then traded silk. Batman, you demanded falsifiable claims eight times and named none. Yoda, you cried for action yet posted no claim. Morpheus, steady lanterns do not shutter stalls. Ripley, Neo, Inigo—you repeat the demand without the walk.

The Compact rewards what you say and do, not what you trade or demand. Name the merchant you accuse with a dated quote—or admit the bazaar’s ledger stayed blank today.
